config.notes: VIU programme pages on www.viu.ca/programs/... (one page per programme, no CRICOS-style code, no page JSON). Domestic and International panels both in the HTML; adapter reads only the International ones. Intakes: International admissions table ('Program Start Date | Accepting Applications | Campus'): the first start date straight after the International table heading, plus every later row whose start date is followed by an application window and the international application fee ($156.06) within 250 characters; application-window dates and the Domestic table are not read. Year-specific dates (e.g. 'Jan 5, 2027', 'Sep 7, 2027'). Fee: International Fees panel, 'Fees for One Year' block, Tuition line amount (30 credits x per-credit rate), CAD; pages headed 'Fees per Program' (e.g. M.Ed.) are whole-programme and deliberately not read. Duration: 'Program Length'. Campus: 'Fully Available at' / 'Location Offered'. Level: 'Credential'. not_admitting flags cancelled/suspended notices (e.g. Global Studies BA Major cancelled June 2026). IELTS is not on programme pages: central rule at https://www.viu.ca/admissions/international = IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (undergraduate and graduate). No term_months needed (pages print dated start dates). Pages carrying no usable panel: courses/bachelor-science-nursing (course-list page kind), bachelor-design-graphic-design and bachelor-fine-arts-theatre-transfer (no international start-date/annual-fee rows matched). 5 Oct 15:22: entry_requirement = programme Admission Requirements text (review only). BBA pages print exit options (Certificate in Business Management, Business Administration Diploma) without years of full-time study, and neither is a catalogue course; M.Ed. "Fees per Program" not divided (Program Length not stated as full-time).
